proves.claim: recordNextIdle on a joined seat with a timeout observation writes one next-idle-timeout event carrying version, engine, lane, minutes and awaited, and refuses a malformed one.

store.logic-board-stats.idle-timeout-eve.why: Without this test, a regression where a timed-out next left no record of the minutes waited and what it awaited would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: recordNextIdle with a finished observation writes one next-finished event per seat however many times it is called, and an unjoined seat is refused NOT_JOINED.

store.logic-board-stats.finished-once.why: Without this test, a regression where a seat's finish was recorded twice, or for a seat that never joined, would pass unnoticed.
